notes.text: In decimal estates a -U/-S suffix pair means unscaled value and scale (BigDecimal parts), not unsigned/signed; name them <noun>Unscaled and <noun>Scale and keep one noun for both.

When identical value groups (unscaled, scale, exponent) are merged into one generated type, name the type and its fields generically; a name taken from the first group (PaymentValue) mislabels the others.
